title: REL-15.5: What Changed In The Data Lake Ingest
body:
HIGHLIGHTS:

REL-15.5 of the Data Lake Ingest rolls out to every tenant on 11 February 2025. Highlights are
faster search and a reworked admin console, with Northwind Systems contributing the search work and
8 customer reports addressed.

FIXES:

Fixes in this release, verified by Data Services on 3 January 2025:
* Fixed the export job that stalled on empty batches
* Updated the bundled TLS library to the current release
* Removed the deprecated bulk endpoint from the public API

UPGRADE NOTES:

Tenants are upgraded automatically during the 22:00-23:30 UTC window; no action is needed. Noah
Fischer managed this release and Yuki Tanaka is the support contact, reachable through the usual
channel.
